independent_closure_audit.scope: Exact rank-tight completion exclusions for 150 generated fixed-prefix spaces, not all five-gate prefixes or the global eight-AND problem. Two full scans independently repeated using row equations; shared engine validated by exhaustive small cases.

prefix_generation_and_solver_checks.preserved_setup_failure: The first six original products leave deficit2, not3. Original continuation-controls command exits1 at the explicit rank precondition before creating that fifth CNF. Four prior successful controls and all failure logs are preserved.
prefix_generation_and_solver_checks.repair: Select lexicographically first six-product subset with exactly3 missing target directions; 78 of84 subsets qualify.
prefix_generation_and_solver_checks.exactness_argument: Three missing truth directions and three new products force every new truth into S=W+target and force their quotient tags independent.

joint_symmetry_derivation.title: Joint first-target-covector / first-product-plane normalization for GF16 multiplication
joint_symmetry_derivation.target: f(x,y)=xy over F16=F2[t]/(t^4+t+1); x bits 0..3, y bits 4..7
joint_symmetry_derivation.fixed_covector: lambda mask 1 means coefficient bit zero, not the trace covector Tr(z); equivalently lambda(z)=Tr(9z).
proof: Let S(x,y)=(a*x^(2^j)+b*y^(2^j),c*x^(2^j)+d*y^(2^j)), with delta=ad+bc nonzero. Then f(S(x,y))=delta*f(x,y)^(2^j)+ac*x^(2^(j+1))+bd*y^(2^(j+1)). The final two terms are F2-linear, so modulo affine functions the target action is D(z)=delta*z^(2^j).

An input substitution is a pullback on both components of the joint state: (lambda,P) maps to (lambda composed with D, P composed with S). Applying the inverse action to lambda but the forward pullback to P is invalid.

Every nonzero lambda is uniquely normalized to coefficient bit zero by scaling x by a nonzero field element. Thus all joint orbits meet the fixed-lambda fiber. A group element connecting two points in that fiber necessarily stabilizes lambda, and orbit-fiber correspondence is exact.

Writing lambda(z)=Tr(ell*z) and input linear forms as Tr(u*x+v*y), pullback by S maps ell to Frobenius^(-j)(delta*ell). The determinant Delta of two trace-coefficient rows transforms by the same rule. Fixing ell0=9 requires delta=Frobenius^j(ell0)/ell0. Therefore the stabilizer consists of four determinant-constrained Frobenius cosets of SL2(F16), has order 4*4080=16320, and is generated by SL2 plus the compensated Frobenius (x,y)->(9*x^2,y^2).

The SL2 generators used are swap, diag(2,2^(-1)), and x->x+y. Their matrix closure was compared exactly with all determinant-one 2x2 field matrices and equals all 4080. The field element 2 is primitive of order 15. Adding independent field scaling and Frobenius generates GL2(F16) semidirect Gal(F16/F2), of order (255*240)*4=244800.

For F16-independent binary planes, Delta is basis independent because every invertible binary 2x2 change of basis has determinant one. SL2 is transitive on planes with fixed Delta: its action on ordered bases of a fixed determinant is transitive, and each binary plane has six ordered bases. Hence each determinant fiber contains 4080/6=680 planes. The normalized invariant Delta/ell0 transforms only by inverse Frobenius, whose nonzero field orbits have sizes 1,2,4,4,4. This yields five stabilizer plane orbits of sizes 680,1360,2720,2720,2720.

F16-dependent binary planes lie in one of 17 field lines. Each line contains 35 binary 2-planes; scalar multiplication splits these into orbits of sizes 5,15,15. Consequently SL2 alone has dependent-plane orbits 85,255,255. Compensated Frobenius fixes the F4 type and merges the other two, yielding stabilizer orbit sizes 85 and 510. This classification is also independently verified using ratios in F4 and direct SL2 orbit enumeration.

The finite enumeration retains all 10795 binary planes and all 161925 joint states. A full-group BFS and a separate fixed-lambda-stabilizer BFS yield exactly the same seven fibers. Every joint orbit has 15 equally sized fibers. A second checker using separately implemented carryless arithmetic verifies trace/determinant invariants for every retained joint state and verifies the SL2-only orbit split.

For a sequential XOR-AND circuit, invertible linear input substitution preserves the number/order of AND gates and every prefix span modulo affine functions. Output basis changes are invertible and affine correction is free. A prefix witness lambda*f in A+span(g1..gi) therefore transforms to the new joint covector and transformed prefix. All other free witness covectors transform simultaneously; independence is preserved.

The first useful gate may be taken to have two linearly independent nonconstant raw-input factors. A first affine/redundant gate can be removed and a shorter circuit padded at the end within an at-most-eight budget. Constants in its factors affect the product only by an affine function. Changing a binary plane basis also changes its product only by an input-linear function since u^2=u; propagating that affine correction through later factors preserves all prefix spans. This justifies using canonical factor pairs instead of ordered affine factor pairs.
